subject: Kestrel Systems - MAP & accelerated implementation timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@kestrelsys.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-26T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Kestrel Systems - MAP kickoff and timeline

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the quantization options for cost control. Our execs gave us a target: go-live for a subset of features by 2025-11-15.

Before we commit, we want to align on a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a realistic implementation cadence. Key constraints on our side:
- SAML SSO must be completed before production access (we have an internal security review week of 10/19).
- Data retention policy — we need a 90-day log retention in EU for EU customers; will need confirmation on region routing.
- Integration points: exports to our analytics pipeline (Kafka), plus batch import for historical data.

Could we run a 60–90 minute MAP workshop next week to draft milestones, owners, and dates? Preferable slots: Tue 8/27 10–11am PT or Wed 8/28 1–2pm PT.

I attached a one-page requirements spreadsheet and a short draft MAP (very rough).

Best,
Sarah Lopez
Program Manager — Platform Integrations
Kestrel Systems

Attachment: kestrel_onboarding_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@kestrelsys.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-26T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel Systems - MAP kickoff and timeline

Sarah — thanks for the clear constraints and the draft. Those windows are good; we can do Tue 8/27 10–11am PT. I've looped Jordan (CS lead) and Soojin (implementation PM) so we can come with an initial milestone slate.

Agenda for the MAP workshop (proposed, 60m):
1) Alignment on go-live scope (subset features) — 10 min
2) Dependency review (SAML, data routing, analytics) — 15 min
3) Milestones & owners (RACI-style) — 20 min
4) Risks / fallbacks and quick wins for first 30 days — 10 min
5) Action items & next steps — 5 min

Pre-work for the workshop: please confirm the SSO IdP type (Okta / Azure AD / Other) and a point-of-contact for your security review. Also confirm whether the Kafka topic schema is stable or if we'll need a schema migration window.

I'll bring a draft MAP doc and a proposed milestone calendar for Nov 15 go-live.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Mina (mobile: +1-415-555-0192)

Attachment: kestrel_map_draft_v1.docx (outline, draft)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-26T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Kestrel MAP prep + owners (please review)

Jordan / Soojin — looped you into the MAP with Kestrel (go-live target 2025-11-15). After the workshop we need a compact implementation timeline and clear owners. Draft owner assignments below — please edit and confirm by EOD.

Draft sprint-style milestones (6 sprints, 2 weeks each, weighted to early infra work):
- Sprint 1 (8/31 - 9/13): SSO proof-of-concept + onboarding sandbox; owner: Soojin (Redwood infra), Kestrel: David Park (security)
- Sprint 2 (9/14 - 9/27): Data pipeline integration (Kafka topics), owner: Jordan (integration), Kestrel: Eng lead
- Sprint 3 (9/28 - 10/11): Model selection + quantization profile validation (perf tests), owner: Mina (CS) + Infra ops
- Sprint 4 (10/12 - 10/25): Staging end-to-end tests and security review window, owner: Soojin
- Sprint 5 (10/26 - 11/08): Cutover prep, docs, runbook and training, owner: Jordan
- Sprint 6 (11/09 - 11/15): Production cutover & verification, owner: Mina / Jordan

Immediate asks for you both:
- Soojin: prepare SSO checklist (metadata, cert exchange process, expected turnaround for Kestrel internal review).
- Jordan: draft the integration acceptance criteria (Kafka schema compatibility, failure modes, throughput targets).

I'll surface this during the MAP workshop and capture any changes live. If either of you sees a hard blocker to Nov 15 given those sprints, flag it now so we can propose a fallback (end of November).

Thanks — Mina

Note: internal only — do not include the draft sprint dates in customer slide until we confirm after the workshop.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@kestrelsys.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-27T10:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel Systems - MAP kickoff and timeline

Thanks for running the workshop this morning — good alignment. A few notes / clarifications based on the discussion:
- Kestrel will own the internal security review and provide a named reviewer by 10/10.
- Redwood will provide a sandbox topic and a schema sample by 9/05.
- For SAML: Kestrel confirmed Okta; we'll start cert exchange in Sprint 1.

Adjusted sprint pairings to reflect effort and QA windows (we added 3 days buffer before the security review week):
- Sprint 1 (8/31 - 9/13): SSO PoC + sandbox — Soojin / Kestrel David Park
- Sprint 2 (9/14 - 9/27): Data integration + schema verification — Jordan / Kestrel Eng
- Sprint 3 (9/28 - 10/11): Model perf + quantization tests — Infra ops / Mina
- Interim buffer (10/12 - 10/18): Security review (Kestrel)
- Sprint 4 (10/19 - 11/01): Staging E2E + remediation — Soojin / Jordan
- Sprint 5 (11/02 - 11/15): Cutover prep + go-live — Cross-team (prod cutover 11/15)

I'm attaching a lightweight acceptance checklist we'll use for integration sign-off.

Jordan Blake
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: integration_acceptance_checklist.pdf (6 items)

From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@kestrelsys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: David Park <d.park@kestrelsys.com>
Date: 2025-08-28T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel Systems - MAP kickoff and timeline

Jordan / Mina — thanks, this looks good and aligns with our internal calendar. Key confirmations:
- Kestrel will provide the security reviewer contact by 10/03 (David Park).
- We'll accept the sprint sequence with the buffer week for the security review.
- Please upload the updated MAP doc and the acceptance checklist to the shared Drive link — I've added a column for our internal owner names.

Next steps (action items):
1) Redwood: upload updated MAP with sprint owners and acceptance criteria (due 8/29) — Mina
2) Redwood: provide sandbox Kafka topic + schema sample (due 9/05) — Jordan
3) Kestrel: share security POC contact + Okta metadata (due 9/10) — Sarah/David

We'll plan a quick check-in on 9/16 to review Sprint 1 progress. If anything slips, we'll trigger the end-of-Nov fallback window.

Regards,
Sarah
